source.check: returned unopposed: 'Twenty-one Unionists and 18 Nationalists were nominated for Omagh Rural Council and thus there will be no contests'; the only nomination for the division in the list (Strabane Chronicle, 24 May 1958, p. 3, block images read)

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 5 June 1958. There was no election: the Unionists lodged nominations for 21 divisions and the Nationalists for 18, with one change on each side (Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1958, p. 11). All 39 members are recorded from the Strabane Chronicle's list of the nominations (24 May 1958, p. 3), which prints no labels. Returned unopposed.
